summary: Objective-C method parsing now treats the low IMP bit as Thumb state only for object::Architecture::Arm. Odd x86-64 method addresses survive both absolute and relative method-list decoding, while 32-bit ARM IMPs remain normalized to their even instruction address.

decisions.detail: The dataset method_t stores 0x100001d2b, while the unconditional imp & !1 in methods.rs changed it to 0x100001d2a. The unpatched command returned a one-byte function containing only return; the patched command returns the metadata address 0x100001d2b and a 290-byte body.

decisions.what: architecture comes from the parsed target, not the path
decisions.detail: ObjcMetadataPass::run reads object::File::architecture() after the Mach-O/fat-slice loader has selected the object and threads that value through both large and small method-list readers. object::Architecture::Arm denotes 32-bit ARM; Aarch64 and X86_64 are distinct variants, so only the ABI that uses bit zero as Thumb state is normalized.

decisions.what: both sides of the low-bit rule are regression-tested
decisions.detail: The vendored x86-64 Mach-O uses an absolute method_t whose IMP is the valid odd entry 0x100000641 and whose preceding even byte is padding. The metadata walk must preserve it. A paired unit test asserts an odd object::Architecture::Arm IMP is still stripped, so deleting normalization to fix x86 would fail. Existing even x86-64 and arm64 fixtures remain covered.

decisions.what: no phase option or stage-model fixture
decisions.detail: This is a strict kuna-analysis metadata-decoding correction: the object format already determines whether bit zero is address or Thumb state. There is no user judgment to expose, and no kuna-decomp phase behavior, option metadata, catalog counter, DIV entry, or stages baseline is involved.

inertness.rule: The result changes only when Objective-C metadata contains an odd IMP and the parsed object architecture is not 32-bit ARM. Even IMPs on every architecture are byte-identical; every non-ObjC analysis is outside this pass; ARM32 retains the previous normalization.
inertness.evidence: The full kuna-analysis crate suite passed 748 unit tests plus 3 integration tests, and the unchanged datatest and stages baselines passed 675/675 and 779/779. The full Rust workspace suite also passed with KUNA_DECOMP_TEST unset.

acceptance.dataset_witness: -[CrackMeManager checkCode:] moved from the incorrect 0x100001d2a, size 1 body to the metadata IMP 0x100001d2b, size 290 with no function error.
acceptance.vendored_twin: macho_objc_odd_imp moved from 0x100000640, size 1 to 0x100000641, size 15 and returns arg1 * 3 + 7.
